intent: According to the Bestsellers report for Q2 2023 (April 1, 2023 to June 30, 2023), which product is the top seller, and how many units of it were sold? (If several products tie for first place, the unit count is enough.)
intent_template: According to the Bestsellers report for {{month}}, which product is the top seller{{and_qty}}

instantiation_dict.and_qty: , and how many units of it were sold? (If several products tie for first place, the unit count is enough.)

eval.answer_sql: SELECT CAST(sum(i.qty_ordered - coalesce(i.qty_canceled, 0)) AS INTEGER) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.state <> 'canceled' AND coalesce(i.product_type, 'simple') NOT IN ('configurable', 'bundle', 'grouped') AND admin_local_date(o.created_at) BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-06-30' GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

eval.answer_sql: SELECT CAST(count(*) AS TEXT) FROM orders o WHERE o.state NOT IN ('new', 'pending_payment') AND admin_local_date(o.created_at) BETWEEN '2023-02-01' AND '2023-02-28' UNION ALL SELECT (printf('%.2f', t) || CASE WHEN t >= 1000 THEN ' |OR| ' || printf('%,.2f', t) ELSE '' END) FROM (SELECT sum(o.grand_total - (CASE WHEN o.state = 'canceled' THEN coalesce(o.total_canceled, o.grand_total) ELSE coalesce(o.total_canceled, 0) END)) AS t FROM orders o WHERE o.state NOT IN ('new', 'pending_payment') AND admin_local_date(o.created_at) BETWEEN '2023-02-01' AND '2023-02-28')
